name: Minecraft: Paper
description: High-performance Minecraft Java server with full Bukkit/Spigot plugin support. The best default for most Minecraft servers.

variables.name: MC_VERSION
variables.label: Minecraft version
variables.description: Pick a version, or leave it on the newest.

install.label: Download the latest Paper build
install.run:
UA="GamePanel/1.0"
VER="{{MC_VERSION}}"
if [ "$VER" = "latest" ] || [ -z "$VER" ]; then
  VER=$(curl -sf -A "$UA" https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const all=Object.values(j.versions||{}).flat().filter(v=>!/-(rc|pre|snapshot)/i.test(v));console.log(all[0]||"");})')
fi
[ -n "$VER" ] || gp_die "Could not resolve a Paper version"
gp_log "Minecraft $VER"
URL=$(curl -sf -A "$UA" "https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/paper/versions/$VER/builds" | node -e 'let d="";process.stdin.on("data",c=>d+=c).on("end",()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const builds=Array.isArray(j)?j:(j.builds||[]);const stable=builds.filter(b=>b.channel==="STABLE");const pick=(stable.length?stable:builds)[0];console.log(pick&&pick.downloads&&pick.downloads["server:default"]?pick.downloads["server:default"].url:"");})')
[ -n "$URL" ] || gp_die "No Paper build available for $VER"
gp_fetch "$URL" server.jar

install.content:
# Accepted through GamePanel on install
eula=true
